# Benchmark record template

🌐 **Language**: [日本語](benchmark-record.md) | **English**

> **Condition for publishing**: A record with any empty environment field is not published. A sample run is never presented as a production estimate.

Save it as `benchmarks/records/<date>-<tool>-<scenario>.md`.

## Environment fields

| Item | Entry |
|---|---|
| Unique ID (date and sequence) | (fill in) |
| Measurement date (JST; state the basis) | (fill in) |
| Region | (fill in) |
| Layout, throughput capacity, storage type and capacity | (fill in) |
| Version, with how it was checked | (fill in) |
| Settings (do not write the alias) | (fill in) |
| Where it runs, OS, network bandwidth | (fill in) |
| Tool and version, checked at measurement time | (fill in) |
| Single value or distribution | (fill in) |
| Threads and concurrent connections | (fill in) |
| Repetitions and aggregation (median, min, or max) | (fill in) |
| Sample run (default) or production estimate (with formula and assumptions) | (fill in) |
| With units; do not mix bits and bytes | (fill in) |
| Script path and arguments | (fill in) |
| Resources created and confirmation of deletion | (fill in) |

## Results and notes

Write measured values with units. Write "not measured" for anything that was not measured.
